name: Dark Water
source:
Deep in the water, where any trace of light can reach, you find yourself drifting idly through the frigid coldness of the sea. In complete darkness, unaware of the wonders hiding just a metres above your head, but conscious of its existence.

What can you do regarding that issue? Absolutely nothing, knowing that if you try to reach for the surface, your body will start to collapse over itself. Surrounded, trapped, confined; fated to live in this perpetual darkness until your last breath…

[I]Or does it?[/i]

[From [url=https://gatoron.itch.io/dark-water]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在水的深处，任何光线都可以到达的地方，你发现自己在寒冷的大海中悠闲地漂流。在完全的黑暗中，没有意识到隐藏在头顶一米处的奇观，但意识到它的存在。

对于这个问题你能做什么？绝对没什么，因为你知道如果你试图到达水面，你的身体就会开始崩溃。被包围、被困、被限制；注定要生活在这永恒的黑暗中，直到你最后一口气……

[I]或者是吗？[/i]

[来自[url=https://gatoron.itch.io/dark-water]Itch.io[/url]]
